_doc: MERCS core palette (06_STYLE_ART.md section 2): the ramps every biome shares and that never change: outline soot, plate iron, bone and linen, the skin ramps, faded cloth, heraldry, blood and fire. A biome palette adds the world's ramps. From look option B 'Peat and Ochre', picked by the director 2026-10-15. Never reorder: colour index is the position in the flattened list.

ramps.name: soot
ramps.purpose: outlines, iron shadow, charred wood, night

ramps.name: skin_neutral
ramps.purpose: the one skin ramp sprites render in; recoloured by index

ramps.name: cloth_faded
ramps.purpose: commoner and dark cloth: dull red pair, dull blue pair

ramps.name: heraldry
ramps.purpose: faction colours only: crimson, gold, blue, white, yellow

ramps.name: blood
ramps.purpose: overlay only: two reds and a dried brown
